transcript: Speaker A: I'm a Brit who moved to Australia for a better life, and somehow ended up with less time to reply to emails. Between organising content, sponsors and doing my business admin, typing everything was just killing my flow. So this is Wispr Flow. I just talk and it writes anywhere I would usually type. It's amazing because it helps me blitz through my emails, my notes, my documents and my DMs. I just speak naturally and it handles punctuation, formatting, even weird names and technical stuff. And if I say actually change that, it understands what I mean and it fixes it really cleanly. So if you're like me, you're short on time and your brain works faster than your fingers, then try Wispr Flow.
